Contract CoCoMEOrderProducts::chooseSupplier(supplierID: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		supplier: Supplier = Supplier.allInstance()->any(s|s.Id = supplierID)
	precondition:
		supplier.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		CurrentOrderProduct.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		let linkExists: Boolean in
		CurrentOrderProduct.Supplier = supplier and
		result = linkExists
}
